"Open Interface language on the module home page or in the module app. Choose Follow system (default), 简体中文, 繁體中文, 한국어, 日本語 or English. Each entry saves its own choice. Changing the setting reopens the module page and changes its settings, dialogs, help and status text. TikTok, region spoofing, caption recognition, AI and TTS retain their own language settings."

"If no caption is generated, fully close and reopen TikTok before trying again. Recognition starts only when the module can verify the current card was fully initialized and is unobstructed; cards with unknown state are skipped. This adaptation covers the recommendation feed caption layer. Search, live streams and Tako have separate caption layers that are not covered."
